elements.label: Figure 2
elements.title: Higher Education Analytical/Conceptual Framework
elements.content:
A multi-tiered conceptual framework diagram organized into four vertical levels with upward-pointing grey arrows connecting levels from bottom to top:

1. Top Level - Higher Level Goals:
   - Label box on right: 'Higher Level Goals'
   - Goal boxes: 'Growth' and 'Shared Prosperity'

2. Second Level - HE Outcomes:
   - Label box on right: 'HE Outcomes'
   - Outcome boxes: 'Research and Innovation', 'Skills', and 'Coverage and Equity'
   - Upward arrows connect 'Research and Innovation' to 'Growth', and 'Coverage and Equity' to 'Shared Prosperity'

3. Third Level (inside main container box) - Policy Levers Outcomes:
   - Label box on right: 'Policy Levers Outcomes'
   - Box 1: 'Research and Technology Transfer'
     - STI strategy/policies
     - Talent management
     - Competitive funds
     - Centers of excellence
     - Links with industry and global R&D frontier
   - Box 2: 'Quality and Relevance'
     - Curriculum & pedagogy
     - Internationalization
     - University-industry links
     - Staffing policies and incentives
     - Teaching excellence
     - Digital and disruptive technologies (cross-cutting)
   - Box 3: 'Access and Equity'
     - Institutional diversity (Non-university, private sector, and online)
     - Networking of HEIs
     - Coordination between MOET, MOLISA, and so on
     - Scholarships and Loans
   - Upward arrows point from these three boxes up toward the HE Outcomes level.

4. Bottom Level (inside main container box) - Enabling Pillars:
   - Label box on right: 'Enabling Pillars'
   - Box 1: 'Enhanced Governance'
     - Government as steward (sets vision and goals, coordinates, supervises, monitors, and finances)
     - Institutional autonomy
     - Institutional accountability
     - Quality assurance
   - Box 2: 'Effective Financing'
     - Resource mobilization (public funding, tuition fees, sustainable cost sharing, PPP, other income generation)
     - Resource allocation (formula-based,
   - Three upward arrows point from the Enabling Pillars to the Policy Levers boxes above.

Source: World Bank.
Note: HE = Higher education; MOLISA = Ministry of Labor, Invalids, and Social Affairs; PPP = Public-private partnership; STI = Science, technology, and innovation.
